# Character Name

Milo Arden

## Age

34 years old

## Role

Restorer of rare books and handwritten archives

## Appearance

Milo is of average height, with wavy black hair, grey eyes, and ink stains that never fully leave his fingers. He usually wears simple dark clothes and round glasses.

## Personality

Patient, discreet, thoughtful, and quietly humorous. He prefers listening before speaking and rarely reacts impulsively.

## Goals

To restore a damaged collection of journals before their contents are permanently lost.

## Motivations

He believes forgotten stories still matter and wants to preserve the work of people who were never recognized.

## Fears

Failing to protect the collection, losing his eyesight, and discovering that some memories were erased intentionally.

## Strengths

Careful, observant, disciplined, reliable, and skilled at solving delicate problems.

## Weaknesses

Overly cautious, emotionally distant, perfectionistic, and slow to trust others.

## Relationships

- Lena: a photographer who documents his restoration work.
- Tomas: his former teacher and current mentor.
- Elise: his younger sister, who wants him to leave the archive and live more freely.
- The Foundation Board: the group funding the restoration project.

## Backstory

Milo grew up above a small second-hand bookstore owned by his grandparents. He learned to repair damaged books as a teenager and later trained in archival restoration. Years later, he was hired to recover a collection of journals found in an abandoned country house.

## Character Arc

Milo begins the story focused only on preserving the past. Over time, he learns that protecting old stories should not prevent him from creating a life of his own.

## Notes

- Collects old bookmarks.
- Drinks black coffee.
- Keeps a notebook of unusual handwriting styles.
- Avoids using pens near finished restorations.
